'''Haranexlah''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she sold medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
